title: Overlapping extractive land use rights increases deforestation and forest degradation in managed natural production forests
abstract: Guyana manages an estimated 5.3 million hectares of old-growth tropical forests, 29% of its total forest area, for timber extraction. Individuals and companies can apply for time-limited leases that allocate access, management, and extraction rights for timber through a concession system. In many tropical regions, including Guyana, a lack of integrated land use planning often leads to overlapping extractive and forest use rights for logging and mining. Overlapping land rights in turn create uncertainty and limit investments toward sustainable forest management, affecting deforestation and forest degradation rates. In this study, we use matched fixed-effect and difference-in-differences panel data models to quantify the impact of establishing logging tenure on deforestation and forest degradation. We assess the impact of different tenure use allocations for Guyana, a high forest cover low deforestation country, utilizing a 31-year (1990–2020) remotely sensed annual time series dataset on deforestation and forest degradation. The rate of forest loss (deforestation plus degradation) in public forests managed by the State with no authorized use allocation activities were 0.062% per year. The issuance of timber concessions increases the probability of deforestation by 33.5% and forest degradation by 8.9% compared to unallocated state forests. Forests with overlapping use rights for timber and mining had a 156% and 19.1% higher probability of deforestation and degradation relative to unallocated public forests and forests where only timber harvesting was authorized, respectively. We conclude that overlapping land use allocations result in conflicting resource use strategies that ultimately will limit sustainability and climate goals related to reducing deforestation and degradation.
abstract_zh: 圭亚那管理着约530万公顷的原始热带森林，占其森林总面积的29%，用于木材采伐。个人和公司可以申请有期限的租约，通过特许经营制度获得木材的经营、管理和采伐权。在包括圭亚那在内的许多热带地区，由于缺乏综合土地利用规划，常常导致采矿和伐木等采掘性用途与森林利用权相互重叠。重叠的土地权利会造成不确定性，并限制对可持续森林管理的投资，进而影响毁林和森林退化的速率。在本研究中，我们采用匹配固定效应模型和双重差分面板数据模型，量化设立伐木特许权对毁林和森林退化的影响。我们利用一个长达31年（1990—2020年）的遥感年度时间序列数据集，评估了圭亚那（一个森林覆盖率高、毁林率低的国家）不同土地利用分配方式的影响。在国家管理、未获授权用途分配的公有森林中，森林损失（毁林加退化）的年均速率为0.062%。与未分配的国有森林相比，木材特许权的发放使毁林概率提高了33.5%，使森林退化概率提高了8.9%。与未分配的公有森林，以及仅授权木材采伐的森林相比，同时存在木材和采矿重叠使用权的森林，毁林和退化的概率分别高出156%和19.1%。我们的结论是，重叠的土地利用分配导致了相互冲突的资源利用策略，最终将限制与减少毁林和森林退化相关的可持续性目标和气候目标的实现。

title: A system-wide assessment of forest biomass production, markets, and carbon
Drainage water management: A review of nutrient load reductions and cost effectiveness
abstract:
Highlights
Reductions of nitrogen due to drainage water management were synthesized from 290 plot-years.
Nitrate reduction was 13.3 kg N/ha/yr (46%) based on a mixed effects modeling analysis.
Dissolved reactive phosphorus and total phosphorus load reductions were 0.04 kg/ha (34%) and 0.06 kg/ha (36%).
Cost of nitrogen reduction was $1 to $11 per kg N removed, with a net benefit if yield increased by 3%.
Abstract.
Drainage water management (DWM) is the practice of seasonally adjusting the drainage outlet elevation with a control structure and is implemented to decrease nutrient loss in drained agricultural landscapes. In this study, we review the effect of DWM on annual nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) loads compared to free drainage and examine its cost-effectiveness using data from around the world published between 1979 and 2022. Studies included in the review were limited to row-crop agriculture without irrigation, with controlled drainage and free drainage compared during the same year. A total of 290 plot-years for N were compiled and analyzed using a mixed effects linear model to assess differences in flow, load, and concentrations and account for within and among site variability. Few studies examined dissolved reactive P (n=7) or total P (n=3); thus, only DRP results from these studies were statistically evaluated using Kruskal-Wallis tests. Analysis of N data showed that DWM reduced N loss on average by 13.3 kg/ha/yr (95% confidence interval: 9.4-17.3 kg/ha/yr), which corresponds to a 46% load removal efficiency (95% confidence interval: 37.4%-54.5%). Drainage water management decreased annual DRP and TP load compared to free drainage by an average of 0.04 kg/ha/yr (mean=34%; range=-35% to 80%) and 0.06 kg/ha/yr (mean=36%; range=7% to 72%), respectively. Economic analysis showed that the cost of N reduction would range from $1 to $11 per kg N removed assuming no yield benefit, while a 3% yield increase would lead to a likely net economic benefit to the producer. Findings indicate that DWM can be an effective practice for decreasing nutrient loading from drained landscapes, however, losses through unmeasured flow paths such as seepage and surface runoff may lead to overestimating the effectiveness of DWM. Additionally, complex interactions among soil organic matter, soil nutrient levels, and water table depths need to be accounted for to ensure both N and P removal is achieved. Recommendations for monitoring discharge and nutrient loads in future DWM studies are provided to better understand the processes influencing nutrient load reductions and/or increases and further quantify the effectiveness of DWM implementation in drained landscapes. Keywords: Agricultural conservation practices, Controlled drainage, Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Subsurface drainage, Water quality.
abstract_zh:
要点
基于290个小区—年数据，综合评估了排水水管理带来的氮素减少。
基于混合效应模型分析，硝酸盐减少量为每公顷每年13.3千克氮（46%）。
溶解性活性磷和总磷负荷分别减少每公顷每年0.04千克（34%）和0.06千克（36%）。
每去除一千克氮的成本为1至11美元，若产量提高3%，则可获得净收益。
摘要。
排水水管理（Drainage Water Management，DWM）是指通过控制结构季节性调节排水出口高度的做法，旨在减少排水农田景观中的养分流失。在本研究中，我们综述了与自由排水相比，DWM对年度氮（N）和磷（P）负荷的影响，并利用1979年至2022年间全球已发表的数据，考察其成本效益。纳入综述的研究仅限于不灌溉的行播作物农业，且控制排水（controlled drainage）与自由排水（free drainage）须在同一年份进行比较。我们共汇编了290个氮素的小区—年数据，并采用混合效应线性模型分析流量、负荷和浓度的差异，同时考虑了地点内部及地点之间的变异。仅有少数研究考察了溶解性活性磷（n=7）或总磷（n=3），因此，仅对这些研究中的DRP结果采用Kruskal-Wallis检验进行统计评估。对氮素数据的分析表明，DWM平均减少氮损失每公顷每年13.3千克（95%置信区间：9.4—17.3千克/公顷/年），相当于46%的负荷去除效率（95%置信区间：37.4%—54.5%）。与自由排水相比，排水水管理使年度溶解性活性磷和总磷负荷平均分别降低每公顷每年0.04千克（平均34%；范围为-35%至80%）和0.06千克（平均36%；范围为7%至72%）。经济分析表明，在假定无产量收益的情况下，每去除一千克氮的减排成本为1至11美元；而产量增加3%则可能使生产者获得净经济收益。研究结果表明，DWM可以有效降低排水农田的养分输入，然而，渗漏和地表径流等未计量的水流路径可能导致对DWM效果的高估。此外，土壤有机质、土壤养分水平与地下水位深度之间复杂的相互作用，需要加以考虑，以确保同时实现氮和磷的去除。文中对未来DWM研究的排水与养分负荷监测提出了建议，以便更好地理解影响养分负荷减少和/或增加的过程，并进一步量化DWM在排水农田中的实施效果。关键词：农业保护性做法，控制排水，氮，磷，地下排水，水质。

title: Economic factors influence net carbon emissions of forest bioenergy expansion
abstract: There is considerable concern that consuming forest biomass for energy will increase net carbon emissions from forests, which is defined as carbon debt. Using a market-based economic model, we test the effects of 51 demand pathways for forest bioenergy on future forest carbon stocks to assess the likelihood of incurring a sustained carbon debt lasting for several decades. We show that potential forest carbon debt from bioenergy expansion, measured as a near-term decrease in forest carbon sequestration relative to a baseline, occurs and persists only under a specific set of assumptions about carbon accounting, markets, policies, and future biomass demands. Finally, we evaluate whether forest regulations restricting biomass sourcing could influence the scale of carbon debt and/or reduce the time needed to recover the carbon debt (payback period). We show that under similar demand pathways and in the absence of direct carbon policies, imposing limits to supply is likely to reduce the payback period but does not avoid initial carbon debt.
abstract_zh: 人们普遍担心，将森林生物质用于能源会增加森林的净碳排放，这被定义为“碳债”（carbon debt）。我们利用一个基于市场的经济模型，检验了森林生物能源需求的51种路径对未来森林碳储量的影响，以评估其引发持续数十年碳债的可能性。我们表明，生物能源扩张所造成的潜在森林碳债（以相对于基准情景的近期森林碳汇减少来衡量）只有在特定的碳核算、市场、政策和未来生物质需求假设下才会发生并持续存在。最后，我们评估了限制生物质来源的森林法规是否会影响碳债的规模和/或缩短偿还碳债所需的时间（回收期）。我们表明，在类似的需求路径下，且在没有直接碳政策的情况下，施加供应限制可能会缩短回收期，但无法避免最初的碳债。

title: Measuring beachgoer preferences for avoiding harmful algal blooms and bacterial warnings
Reporting carbon fluxes from unmanaged forest
abstract: Unmanaged land areas are not included in current national reports on greenhouse gas emissions for the Paris Agreement. Here, we argue that carbon dioxide fluxes from all forest land need to be recorded in order to help tracking progress towards global climate targets.
abstract_zh: 目前，未经管理的土地面积未被纳入依据《巴黎协定》编制的国家温室气体排放报告。在此，我们主张应当记录所有林地的二氧化碳通量，以帮助追踪实现全球气候目标的进展。

title: An analysis of migrant characteristics in forest-dwelling communities in northern Guatemala
Climate change and timber in Latin America: Will the forestry sector flourish under climate change?
Costs of forest carbon sequestration in the presence of climate change impacts
abstract: Forests play a critical role in mitigating climate change, and, at the same time, are predicted to experience large-scale impacts of climate change that will affect the efficiency of forests in mitigation efforts. Projections of future carbon sequestration potential typically do not account for the changing economic costs of timber and agricultural production and land use change. We integrated a dynamic forward-looking economic optimization model of global land use with results from a dynamic global vegetation model and meta-analysis of climate impacts on crop yields to project future carbon sequestration in forests. We find that the direct impacts of climate change on forests, represented by changes in dieback and forest growth, and indirect effects due to lost crop productivity, together result in a net gain of 17 Gt C in aboveground forest carbon storage from 2000 to 2100. Increases in climate-driven forest growth rates will result in an 81%–99% reduction in costs of reaching a range of global forest carbon stock targets in 2100, while the increases in dieback rates are projected to raise the costs by 57%–132%. When combined, these two direct impacts are expected to reduce the global costs of climate change mitigation in forests by more than 70%. Inclusion of the third, indirect impact of climate change on forests through reduction in crop yields, and the resulting expansion of cropland, raises the costs by 11%–38% and widens the uncertainty range. While we cannot rule out the possibility of climate change increasing mitigation costs, the central outcomes of the simultaneous impacts of climate change on forests and agriculture are 64%–86% reductions in the mitigation costs. Overall, the results suggest that concerns about climate driven dieback in forests should not inhibit the ambitions of policy makers in expanding forest-based climate solutions.
abstract_zh: 森林在减缓气候变化中发挥着关键作用，同时，预计森林也将遭受大规模的气候变化影响，从而影响其在减缓行动中的效率。未来碳汇潜力的预测通常未考虑木材和农业生产经济成本以及土地利用变化的变动。我们将一个动态前瞻性的全球土地利用经济优化模型，与一个动态全球植被模型的结果以及气候变化对作物产量影响的元分析相结合，以预测未来森林的碳固存。我们发现，气候变化对森林的直接影响（以枯死和森林生长的变化来体现）以及因作物生产力下降而产生的间接影响，共同导致2000年至2100年间地上森林碳储量净增加17吉吨碳。气候驱动的森林生长速率提高，将使在2100年实现一系列全球森林碳储量目标的成本降低81%—99%，而枯死率的上升则预计使成本提高57%—132%。当这两种直接影响共同作用时，预计将使全球森林中减缓气候变化的成本降低70%以上。若纳入气候变化通过减少作物产量并导致耕地扩张而产生的第三种间接影响，成本将提高11%—38%，并扩大不确定性范围。虽然我们不能排除气候变化使减缓成本上升的可能性，但森林与农业所受气候变化影响同时作用的核心结果，是减缓成本降低64%—86%。总体而言，结果表明，对于气候驱动的森林枯死的担忧，不应阻碍政策制定者扩大以森林为基础的气候解决方案的雄心。

title: Efficiency of forest carbon policies at intensive and extensive margins
abstract: The economic potential of forest carbon sequestration is widely acknowledged. However, no consensus has been reached regarding the appropriate policy instrument for promoting carbon sequestration. In this study, we develop a dynamic framework to measure the effects and efficiencies of alternative carbon policies. A stylized optimal control model of the timber market is first employed to illustrate the mechanisms through which different policies affect the decision making of the forest sector at the extensive margin (i.e., changing forest areas) and the intensive margin (i.e., changing harvest ages). We then introduce carbon price projections and species‐specific production information into a multi‐age dynamic timber market model. Different carbon policies are simulated numerically. Our results reveal that a carbon tax on forest emissions without compensating for sequestration leads to net carbon emissions and, thus, is the least efficient policy choice. Further, policies that do not increases carbon uptake at the intensive margin result in very high efficiency losses. A per‐hectare land subsidy may be more than 10 times more expensive than a per‐ton carbon tax and subsidy policy or a carbon subsidy policy.
abstract_zh: 森林碳固存的经济潜力已得到广泛认可。然而，对于促进碳固存应采用何种适当的政策工具，学界尚未达成共识。在本研究中，我们构建了一个动态框架，用以衡量不同碳政策的效果和效率。我们首先利用一个简化的最优控制木材市场模型，阐明不同政策影响林业部门在外延边际（即改变森林面积）和集约边际（即改变采伐年龄）上决策的机制。随后，我们将碳价格预测和分树种的生产信息引入多龄期动态木材市场模型中。我们对不同碳政策进行了数值模拟。结果表明，对森林排放征收碳税而不对固存进行补偿，会导致净碳排放增加，因此是效率最低的政策选择。此外，不能在集约边际上增加碳吸收的政策，会造成非常高的效率损失。按每公顷的土地补贴，其成本可能是每吨碳税与补贴政策或碳补贴政策的10倍以上。

title: How the future of the global forest sink depends on timber demand, forest management, and carbon policies
abstract: Deforestation has contributed significantly to net greenhouse gas emissions, but slowing deforestation, regrowing forests and other ecosystem processes have made forests a net sink. Deforestation will still influence future carbon fluxes, but the role of forest growth through aging, management, and other silvicultural inputs on future carbon fluxes are critically important but not always recognized by bookkeeping and integrated assessment models. When projecting the future, it is vital to capture how management processes affect carbon storage in ecosystems and wood products. This study uses multiple global forest sector models to project forest carbon impacts across 81 shared socioeconomic (SSP) and climate mitigation pathway scenarios. We illustrate the importance of modeling management decisions in existing forests in response to changing demands for land resources, wood products and carbon. Although the models vary in key attributes, there is general agreement across a majority of scenarios that the global forest sector could remain a carbon sink in the future, sequestering 1.2-5.8 GtCO2e/yr over the next century. Carbon fluxes in the baseline scenarios that exclude climate mitigation policy ranged from -0.8 to 4.9 GtCO2e/yr, highlighting the strong influence of SSPs on forest sector model estimates. Improved forest management can jointly increase carbon stocks and harvests without expanding forest area, suggesting that carbon fluxes from managed forests systems deserve more careful consideration by the climate policy community.
abstract_zh: 森林砍伐已对温室气体净排放造成了显著影响，但放缓森林砍伐、森林再生以及其他生态系统过程，使森林已成为净碳汇。毁林仍将影响未来的碳通量，但森林因树龄增长、经营管理及其他造林投入而产生的生长作用，对未来碳通量至关重要，却常常未被核算模型和综合评估模型所认识。在预测未来时，关键在于体现管理过程如何影响生态系统和木制产品中的碳储存。本研究利用多个全球森林部门模型，在81种共享社会经济路径（SSP）和气候减缓路径情景下预测森林的碳影响。我们说明了在现有森林中，针对土地、木制产品和碳资源需求变化所做的管理决策建模的重要性。尽管各模型在关键属性上有所不同，但大多数情景普遍一致认为，全球森林部门在未来仍可能保持碳汇地位，在下一个世纪每年固存1.2至5.8吉吨二氧化碳当量。在排除气候减缓政策的基准情景中，碳通量为每年负0.8至正4.9吉吨二氧化碳当量，突显了SSP对森林部门模型估计的强烈影响。改善森林管理可以在不扩大森林面积的前提下，同时提高碳储量和木材采伐量，这表明管理林的碳通量值得气候政策界给予更审慎的考虑。

title: The effect of carbon fertilization on naturally regenerated and planted US forests
abstract: Over the last half century in the United States, the per-hectare volume of wood in trees has increased, but it is not clear whether this increase has been driven by forest management, forest recovery from past land uses, such as agriculture, or other environmental factors such as elevated carbon dioxide, nitrogen deposition, or climate change. This paper uses empirical analysis to estimate the effect of elevated carbon dioxide on aboveground wood volume in temperate forests of the United States. To accomplish this, we employ matching techniques that allow us to disentangle the effects of elevated carbon dioxide from other environmental factors affecting wood volume and to estimate the effects separately for planted and natural stands. We show that elevated carbon dioxide has had a strong and consistently positive effect on wood volume while other environmental factors yielded a mix of both positive and negative effects. This study, by enabling a better understanding of how elevated carbon dioxide and other anthropogenic factors are influencing forest stocks, can help policymakers and other stakeholders better account for the role of forests in Nationally Determined Contributions and global mitigation pathways to achieve a 1.5 degree Celsius target.
abstract_zh: 在过去的半个世纪里，美国每公顷树木的木材蓄积量有所增加，但尚不清楚这一增长是由森林经营、森林从以往农业等土地利用中恢复，还是由二氧化碳浓度升高、氮沉降或气候变化等其他环境因素所驱动的。本文采用实证分析，估计二氧化碳浓度升高对美国温带森林地上木材蓄积量的影响。为此，我们采用匹配技术，将二氧化碳浓度升高的影响与影响木材蓄积量的其他环境因素区分开来，并分别估计人工林和天然林的效应。我们表明，二氧化碳浓度升高对木材蓄积量具有持续、显著的正向作用，而其他环境因素的影响则有正有负。本研究有助于更好地理解二氧化碳浓度升高及其他人为因素如何影响森林蓄积量，从而帮助政策制定者和其他利益相关方在国家自主贡献以及实现1.5摄氏度温控目标的全球减缓路径中，更好地考虑森林的作用。

title: The time value of carbon storage
abstract: Widespread concern about the risks of global climate change is increasingly focused on the urgent need for action (IPCC, 2018; IPCC, 2021), and natural climate solutions are a critical component of global strategies to achieve low temperature targets (e.g. Griscom et al. 2017, Roe et al. 2019). Yet to date, the full potential of natural systems to store carbon has not been leveraged because policy-makers have required long-term contracts to compensate for permanence concerns, and these long-term contracts substantially raise costs and limit deployment. In this paper, we lay out the rationale that our time preference for early action leads to the conclusion that multiple tons of short-term storage of carbon in ecosystem stocks can be considered to have equal value – as measured by the social cost of carbon -- as 1 ton of carbon sequestered permanently. This equivalence can be used to quantify the value of short-term carbon storage, thereby removing one of the most significant barriers to participation in the carbon market and enabling the full climate mitigation potential of the land sector to be realized.
abstract_zh: 人们对全球气候变化风险的广泛关注，日益集中于采取行动的紧迫需要（IPCC, 2018；IPCC, 2021），而自然气候解决方案是实现低温目标的全球战略的关键组成部分（例如 Griscom et al. 2017，Roe et al. 2019）。然而，迄今为止，自然系统的全部碳储存潜力尚未得到充分利用，因为政策制定者要求签订长期合同以应对永久性问题，而这些长期合同大幅提高了成本，并限制了推广。在本文中，我们阐述了这样一个论点：我们对早期行动的时间偏好，使得生态系统碳储量中多吨的短期碳储存，在以社会碳成本衡量时，可被视为与1吨永久固存的碳具有同等价值。这种等价关系可用于量化短期碳储存的价值，从而消除碳市场参与中最主要的障碍之一，并使土地部门的全部减缓潜力得以实现。

title: Assessing the long-term interactions of climate change and timber markets on forest land and carbon storage
abstract: This study provides a comprehensive assessment of the environmental and economic impacts of climate change on global and regional forests from now through 2200. By integrating the representative concentration pathway (RCP) 2.6 and RCP 8.5 emission scenarios with climate models, a vegetation model, socio-economic scenarios, and a forest economic model, the study explores long run adjustments of both ecosystems and markets to climate change that have not been studied before. The ecological model suggests that global forest productivity increases under RCP 8.5. The overall supply of timber expands faster than demand through the 23rd century lowering timber prices and creating net benefits in the timber sector. Consumers benefit the most from the lower prices but these same low prices tend to damage forest owners, especially in the tropics. Even without a formal sequestration policy, average global forest carbon is projected to increase by 6%–8% by 2100. Under the RCP 2.6, forest carbon remains stable through 2200 but under RCP 8.5 it is simulated to increase by another 8% with a very heterogeneous distribution across world regions. Under both RCPs, global forest area is projected to increase relative to a no-climate change case until 2150, but possibly decline thereafter.
abstract_zh: 本研究对气候变化对全球和区域森林的环境与经济影响进行了全面评估，时间跨度从现在直至2200年。通过整合代表性浓度路径（RCP）2.6和RCP 8.5排放情景与气候模式、植被模型、社会经济情景以及森林经济模型，本研究探讨了生态系统和市场在气候变化下的长期调整，这些调整此前尚未被研究。生态模型表明，在RCP 8.5情景下全球森林生产力会提高。木材的总供给在至23世纪期间增长快于需求，从而压低木材价格，并为木材行业带来净收益。消费者受益最多，因为价格更低，但同样的低价也会损害森林所有者的利益，尤其是热带地区的森林所有者。即使没有正式的固碳政策，预计到2100年全球森林碳平均也将增加6%—8%。在RCP 2.6情景下，森林碳储量在2200年前保持稳定，但在RCP 8.5情景下，模拟显示其将再增加8%，且在世界各区域间分布极不均衡。在两种RCP情景下，全球森林面积相对于无气候变化的情景，预计至2150年前都将增加，但此后可能下降。

title: Estimating global land system impacts of timber plantations using MAgPIE 4.3
Land-based measures to mitigate climate change: Potential and feasibility by country
Carbon and market effects of US forest taxation policy
Climate Change and Forests
abstract: Forests have become an important carbon sink in the last century, with management and carbon fertilization offsetting nearly all of the carbon emitted due to deforestation and conversion of land into agricultural uses. Society appears already to have decided that forests will play an equally ambitious role in the future. Given this, economists are needed to help better understand the efficiency of efforts society may undertake to expand forests, protect them from losses, manage them more intensively, or convert them into wood products, including biomass energy. A rich literature exists on this topic, but a number of critical information gaps persist, representing important opportunities for economists to advance knowledge in the future. This article reviews the literature on forests and climate change and provides some thoughts on potential future research directions.
abstract_zh: 在上个世纪，森林已成为重要的碳汇，其中，经营管理与碳施肥效应几乎抵消了因毁林和土地转为农业用途而排放的全部碳。社会似乎已经决定，森林将在未来发挥同样积极的作用。鉴于此，经济学家有必要帮助更好地理解社会为扩大森林、保护森林免受损失、加强森林经营或将其转化为木制产品（包括生物质能源）而可能采取的各类努力的效率。关于这一主题已有大量文献，但仍存在若干重要的信息空白，这为经济学家未来推进知识提供了重要机会。本文回顾了关于森林与气候变化的文献，并就未来潜在的研究方向提出了一些看法。

title: Forests: Carbon sequestration, biomass energy, or both?
abstract: There is a continuing debate over the role that woody bioenergy plays in climate mitigation. This paper clarifies this controversy and illustrates the impacts of woody biomass demand on forest harvests, prices, timber management investments and intensity, forest area, and the resulting carbon balance under different climate mitigation policies. Increased bioenergy demand increases forest carbon stocks thanks to afforestation activities and more intensive management relative to a no-bioenergy case. Some natural forests, however, are converted to more intensive management, with potential biodiversity losses. Incentivizing both wood-based bioenergy and forest sequestration could increase carbon sequestration and conserve natural forests simultaneously. We conclude that the expanded use of wood for bioenergy will result in net carbon benefits, but an efficient policy also needs to regulate forest carbon sequestration.
abstract_zh: 关于木质生物能源在气候减缓中所扮演的角色，学界一直存在争论。本文厘清了这一争议，并阐明了在不同气候减缓政策下，木质生物质需求对森林采伐、价格、林木经营投资和强度、森林面积以及由此产生的碳平衡的影响。与无生物能源情景相比，生物能源需求的增加，由于造林活动和更集约的经营，提高了森林碳储量。然而，一些天然林会被转为更集约的经营，这可能导致生物多样性丧失。同时激励木质生物能源和森林碳固存，有望在增加碳固存的同时保护天然林。我们的结论是，扩大木材用于生物能源将带来净碳效益，但高效的政策还需要对森林碳固存进行规范。

abstract_zh: 森林对于稳定气候至关重要，但在空间、时间和利益相关方群体之间，减缓成本仍不确定。利用全球木材模型，我们针对16个区域，在每吨二氧化碳5至100美元的碳价情景下，预测了四种减排活动的减缓潜力与成本。我们预测，到2055年，全球减缓潜力为每年0.6至6.0吉吨二氧化碳，成本为每年2至3930亿美元，其中避免热带毁林占总减缓量的30%至54%。较高的碳价通过温带和北方生物群区的轮伐与森林经营活动，激励了更大比例的减排。在每吨二氧化碳35至100美元的价格下，到2055年，森林面积相对于基准情景增加4.15亿至8.75亿公顷，其中集约化人工林占相当比例。

title: Timber or carbon? Evaluating forest conservation strategies through a discrete choice experiment
Evidence that a national REDD+ program reduces tree cover loss and carbon emissions in a high forest cover, low deforestation country
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
Reducing emissions from deforestation and forest degradation (REDD+) is a climate change mitigation policy in which rich countries provide payments to developing countries for protecting their forests. In 2009, the countries of Norway and Guyana entered into one of the first bilateral REDD+ programs, with Norway offering to pay US$250 million to Guyana if annual deforestation rates remained below 0.056% from 2010 to 2015. To quantify the impact of this national REDD+ program, we construct a counterfactual times-series trajectory of annual tree cover loss using synthetic matching. This analytical approach allows us to quantify tree cover loss that would have occurred in the absence of the Norway-Guyana REDD+ program. We found that the Norway-Guyana REDD+ program reduced tree cover loss by 35% during the implementation period (2010 to 2015), equivalent to 12.8 million tons of avoided CO
2
emissions. Our analysis indicates that national REDD+ payments attenuated the effect of increases in gold prices, an internationally traded commodity that is the primary deforestation driver in Guyana. Overall, we found strong evidence that the program met the additionality criteria of REDD+. However, we found that tree cover loss increased after the payments ended, and therefore, our results suggest that without continued payments, forest protection is not guaranteed. On the issue of leakage, which is complex and difficult to quantify, a multinational REDD+ program for a region could address leakage that results from differences in forest policies between neighboring countries.
abstract_zh: 减少毁林和森林退化所致排放（REDD+）是一项气候变化减缓政策，即富裕国家向发展中国家支付费用，以保护其森林。2009年，挪威与圭亚那签订了最早的双边REDD+项目之一，挪威提出，如果圭亚那在2010至2015年间的年毁林率保持在0.056%以下，将向其支付2.5亿美元。为量化这一国家级REDD+项目的影响，我们利用合成匹配方法构建了年度树冠损失的反事实时间序列轨迹。这一分析方法使我们能够量化在没有挪威—圭亚那REDD+项目的情况下本应发生的树冠损失。我们发现，挪威—圭亚那REDD+项目在实施期间（2010至2015年）使树冠损失减少了35%，相当于避免了1280万吨二氧化碳排放。我们的分析表明，国家级REDD+付费削弱了黄金价格上涨的影响，而黄金是一种国际贸易商品，也是圭亚那毁林的主要驱动因素。总体而言，我们发现有力证据表明，该项目满足了REDD+的额外性标准。然而，我们也发现，付费结束后树冠损失随之增加，因此我们的结果表明，若没有持续付费，森林保护便无法得到保障。关于泄漏问题，由于其复杂且难以量化，区域性的多国REDD+项目可以解决相邻国家之间森林政策差异所导致的泄漏问题。

title: Potential complementarity between forest carbon sequestration incentives and biomass energy expansion
State of the Art Methods to Project Forest Carbon Stocks
abstract: This special issue provides a broad range of potential methodologies, based in economics, for projecting forest carbon stocks. Papers included highlight new analyses from various economists that have projected carbon fluxes nationally and globally. Through carefully designed research, these authors have provided deep insights into methods that can be applied broadly.
abstract_zh: 本期特刊提供了一系列以经济学为基础、可用于预测森林碳储量的潜在方法。所收录的论文重点介绍了多位经济学家在预测国家和全球碳通量方面的新分析。通过精心设计的研究，这些作者对可广泛应用的方法提供了深刻的见解。

title: The Influence of Parametric Uncertainty on Projections of Forest Land Use, Carbon, and Markets
abstract: This paper uses Monte Carlo methods and regression analysis to assess the role of uncertainty in yield function and land supply elasticity parameters on land use, carbon, and market outcomes in a long-term dynamic model of the global forest sector. The results suggest that parametric uncertainty has little influence on projected future timber prices and global output, but it does have important implications for regional projections of outputs. A wide range of outcomes are possible for timber outputs, depending on growth and elasticity parameters. Timber output in the U.S., for instance, could change by —67 to +98 million m3 per year by 2060. Despite uncertainty in the parameters, our analysis suggests that the temperate zone may sequester +30 to +79 Pg C by 2060 and +58 to +114 Pg C by 2090 while the tropics are projected to store —35 to +70 Pg C and —33 to +73 Pg C for the same time periods, respectively. Attributional analysis shows that uncertainty in the parameters regulating forest growth has a more important impact on projections of future carbon storage than uncertainty in the land supply elasticity parameters. Moreover, the results suggest that understanding growth parameters in regions with large current carbon stocks is most important for making future projections of carbon storage.
abstract_zh: 本文运用蒙特卡洛方法和回归分析，评估产量函数和土地供给弹性参数的不确定性，对一个长期动态全球森林部门模型中土地利用、碳和市场结果的影响。结果表明，参数不确定性对预测的未来木材价格和全球产出影响甚微，但对区域产出预测却具有重要意义。木材产出的结果范围很大，取决于生长参数和弹性参数。例如，到2060年，美国的木材产量每年可能变化负6700万至正9800万立方米。尽管参数存在不确定性，我们的分析表明，到2060年，温带地区可能固存正30至79拍克碳，到2090年可能固存正58至114拍克碳；而同期热带地区预计将储存负35至正70拍克碳和负33至正73拍克碳。归因分析表明，与土地供给弹性参数的不确定性相比，调节森林生长的参数的不确定性，对未来碳储量预测的影响更为重要。此外，结果表明，理解当前碳储量较大地区的生长参数，对于做出未来碳储量预测最为重要。

title: The Net Carbon Emissions from Historic Land Use and Land Use Change
abstract: Deforestation from timber harvests and farmland conversions have led to 565 GtCO2 (billion tons of carbon dioxide) being emitted into the atmosphere. Taking into account natural regeneration on forestland, Houghton (2003, 2008) and Houghton et al. (2012) estimate that deforestation has caused a net loss of 484 GtCO2 since 1900 which is about one third of all manmade emissions. However, these estimates do not take into account the substantial investment into fire management, plantations, and replanting since 1950, as well as the effect of carbon fertilization on a younger forest. We compare the outcome of a deforestation scenario with subsequent forest management with what would have happened if the natural forest in 1900 had not been harvested thereafter. Deforestation plus forest management suggests current forests actually hold about 94 GtCO2 more today than they did in 1900. However, natural forests would have held an additional 186 GtCO2. Human activities on forestland have therefore caused about 92 GtCO2 of net emissions since 1900. The effect of manmade land use and land use change is relatively small compared to the 1294 GtCO2 from industrial emissions over the same time period (Marland et al., 2008).
abstract_zh: 木材采伐和农田转换导致的毁林，已向大气排放了5650亿吨二氧化碳（以十亿吨二氧化碳计）。考虑到林地的自然再生，Houghton（2003，2008）以及Houghton等人（2012）估计，自1900年以来，毁林已造成4840亿吨二氧化碳的净损失，约占全部人为排放量的三分之一。然而，这些估计未考虑1950年以来在森林火灾管理、人工林和补植方面的大量投入，也未考虑碳施肥对较年轻森林的影响。我们比较了一种毁林情景（并辅以后续森林管理）与若1900年的天然林此后未被采伐时可能出现的情况。毁林加森林管理的结果表明，与1900年相比，当今的森林实际上多储存了约940亿吨二氧化碳。然而，天然林本应多储存1860亿吨二氧化碳。因此，自1900年以来，人类在林地上的活动共造成了约920亿吨二氧化碳的净排放。与同期12940亿吨工业排放量（Marland et al., 2008）相比，人为土地利用和土地利用变化的影响相对较小。

Cumulative global forest carbon implications of regional bioenergy expansion policies
abstract: Several previous studies have evaluated the potential greenhouse gas (GHG) benefits of forest biomass energy relative to fossil fuel equivalents over different spatial scales and time frames and applying a variety of methodologies. This paper contributes to this literature through an analysis of multiple projected sources of biomass demand growth in different regions of the world using a detailed intertemporal optimization model of the global forest sector. Given the range of current policies incentivizing bioenergy expansion globally, evaluating the combined global implications of regional bioenergy expansion efforts is critical for understanding the extent to which renewable energy supplied from forest biomass can contribute to various policy goals (including GHG emissions mitigation). Unlike previous studies that have been more regionally focused, this study provides a global perspective, illustrating how large potential demand increases for forest biomass in one or multiple regions can alter future forest management trends, markets, and forest carbon sequestration in key timber supply regions. Results show that potential near term (2015–2030) biomass demand growth in the U.S., Europe, and elsewhere can drive forest resource investment at the intensive and extensive margins, resulting in a net increase in forest carbon stocks for most regions of the world. When the reallocation of biomass away from traditional pulp and sawtimber markets is accounted for, net forest carbon sequestration increases (that stored on the land and in wood products) by 9.4 billion tons CO 2 over the near term and 15.4 billion tons CO 2 by 2095. Even if most of the increased forest biomass demand arises from one region (e.g., Europe) due to a particularly strong promotion of forest bioenergy expansion, changes in forest management globally in anticipation of this demand increase could result in carbon beneficial outcomes that can be shared by most regions.
abstract_zh: 区域生物能源扩张政策对全球森林碳汇的累积影响。此前已有多项研究，采用不同方法、在不同空间尺度和时间跨度下，评估了林业生物质能源相对于化石燃料等价物的潜在温室气体（GHG）效益。本文通过一个详细的全球林业跨期优化模型，分析世界不同地区多种预期的生物质需求增长来源，从而对该文献作出贡献。鉴于当前全球范围内激励生物能源扩张的政策众多，评估各地区生物能源扩张努力的综合全球影响，对于理解林业生物质所提供的可再生能源在多大程度上有助于实现各项政策目标（包括温室气体减排）至关重要。与以往更侧重区域层面的研究不同，本研究提供全球视角，阐明一个或多个地区林业生物质需求的大幅潜在增长，如何改变未来的森林管理趋势、市场以及关键木材供应地区的森林碳汇。结果显示，美国、欧洲及其他地区在2015至2030年近期内的生物质需求增长潜力，可在集约和粗放两个边际上推动森林资源投资，使全球大部分地区的森林碳储量实现净增长。若将生物质从传统纸浆和锯材市场的再配置考虑在内，近期（未来十五年）内净森林碳汇（包括陆地和木制品中的储存）将增加94亿吨CO2，到2095年将增加154亿吨CO2。即使大部分增加的林业生物质需求来自单一地区（例如欧洲），这是由于该地区大力推动林业生物能源扩张，全球范围内为应对这一需求增长而进行的森林管理变化，仍可能带来有利于气候的结果，且多数地区可共享其收益。

title: Do US Anglers Care about Harmful Algal Blooms? A Discrete Choice Experiment of Lake Erie Recreational Anglers
Global cost estimates of forest climate mitigation with albedo: a new integrative policy approach
abstract: Climate change mitigation policies have usually considered forest-based actions as cheap and fast options to reduce CO 2 concentration in the atmosphere and slow down global warming. Most economic analyses, however, have ignored the effects of these actions on land surface albedo and the resulting effect on energy balance and temperature. This study estimates the marginal cost of forest mitigation associated with both carbon sequestration and albedo change, by introducing regional and forest-specific albedo information in a global dynamic forestry model. Our analysis indicates that traditional forest sequestration policies have underestimated the costs of climate mitigation, driving forest-based actions in regions where subsequent changes in albedo are significant. To reduce this inefficiency, this paper proposes a novel approach where both carbon sequestration and albedo effect are incorporated into pricing. Our results suggest that, under the same carbon price path, the integrative policy provides greater net global mitigation in absolute terms and per hectare of forest, and thus it is more efficient and less intrusive than the traditional policy.
abstract_zh: 气候变化减缓政策通常将基于森林的行动视为降低大气CO2浓度、减缓全球变暖的廉价且见效快的选择。然而，大多数经济分析忽视了这些行动对地表反照率的影响，以及由此对能量平衡和气温产生的效应。本研究通过在全球动态林业模型中引入区域性和森林特定的反照率信息，估算了与碳封存和反照率变化相关的森林减缓边际成本。我们的分析表明，传统的森林固碳政策低估了气候减缓成本，从而驱动了在后续反照率变化显著的地区开展基于森林的行动。为减少这种低效率，本文提出一种新方法，将碳封存与反照率效应同时纳入定价。我们的结果表明，在相同的碳价路径下，综合政策在绝对量以及每公顷森林的意义上都能提供更大的全球净减缓效果，因此比传统政策更有效率、干预程度更低。

Will US Forests Continue to Be a Carbon Sink?
abstract: This paper develops structural dynamic methods to project future carbon fluxes in forests. These methods account for land management changes on both the intensive and extensive margins, both of which are critical components of future carbon fluxes. When implemented, the model suggests that U.S. forests remain a carbon sink through most of the coming century, sequestering 128 Tg C y−1. Constraining forestland to its current boundaries and constraining management to current levels reduce average sequestration by 25 to 28 Tg C y−1. An increase in demand leads to increased management and greater sequestration in forests. The results are robust to climate change. (JEL Q23, Q54)
abstract_zh: 本文发展了结构动态方法，用以预测森林未来的碳通量。这些方法同时考虑集约和粗放两个边际上的土地管理变化，二者都是未来碳通量的关键组成部分。模型实施结果表明，在本世纪大部分时间内，美国森林仍将是碳汇，每年封存1.28亿吨碳（Tg C y⁻¹）。若将林地约束在当前边界内、并将管理约束在当前水平，平均封存量将减少每年2,500万至2,800万吨碳。需求增加会带来更多的管理和更大的森林碳封存。研究结果对气候变化具有稳健性。（JEL Q23, Q54）

title: Assessing climate change impacts, benefits of mitigation, and uncertainties on major global forest regions under multiple socioeconomic and emissions scenarios
abstract: We analyze a set of simulations to assess the impact of climate change on global forests where MC2 dynamic global vegetation model (DGVM) was run with climate simulations from the MIT Integrated Global System Model-Community Atmosphere Model (IGSM-CAM) modeling framework. The core study relies on an ensemble of climate simulations under two emissions scenarios: a business-as-usual reference scenario (REF) analogous to the IPCC RCP8.5 scenario, and a greenhouse gas mitigation scenario, called POL3.7, which is in between the IPCC RCP2.6 and RCP4.5 scenarios, and is consistent with a 2 °C global mean warming from pre-industrial by 2100. Evaluating the outcomes of both climate change scenarios in the MC2 model shows that the carbon stocks of most forests around the world increased, with the greatest gains in tropical forest regions. Temperate forest regions are projected to see strong increases in productivity offset by carbon loss to fire. The greatest cost of mitigation in terms of effects on forest carbon stocks are projected to be borne by regions in the southern hemisphere. We compare three sources of uncertainty in climate change impacts on the world's forests: emissions scenarios, the global system climate response (i.e. climate sensitivity), and natural variability. The role of natural variability on changes in forest carbon and net primary productivity (NPP) is small, but it is substantial for impacts of wildfire. Forest productivity under the REF scenario benefits substantially from the CO 2 fertilization effect and that higher warming alone does not necessarily increase global forest carbon levels. Our analysis underlines why using an ensemble of climate simulations is necessary to derive robust estimates of the benefits of greenhouse gas mitigation. It also demonstrates that constraining estimates of climate sensitivity and advancing our understanding of CO 2 fertilization effects may considerably reduce the range of projections.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了一组模拟，以评估气候变化对全球森林的影响。模拟中，MC2动态全球植被模型（DGVM）以麻省理工学院综合全球系统模型—社区大气模式（IGSM-CAM）建模框架生成的气候模拟作为输入。核心研究依赖于两种排放情景下的气候模拟集合：一是类似于IPCC RCP8.5情景的照常排放参考情景（REF），二是温室气体减排情景POL3.7，其位于IPCC RCP2.6与RCP4.5情景之间，与到2100年相对工业化前全球平均升温2摄氏度的目标一致。在MC2模型中对两种气候变化情景的结果进行评估后发现，全球大多数森林的碳储量有所增加，热带森林地区增幅最大。温带森林地区预计生产力将大幅提高，但部分被火灾造成的碳损失所抵消。就森林碳储量而言，减缓成本最大的部分预计将由南半球地区承担。我们比较了世界森林气候变化影响中的三类不确定性来源：排放情景、全球系统气候响应（即气候敏感性）以及自然变率。自然变率对森林碳和净初级生产力（NPP）变化的作用较小，但对野火影响而言则相当显著。在REF情景下，森林生产力从CO2施肥效应中获益颇多，而仅仅更高的升温并不一定会增加全球森林碳储量。我们的分析说明了为何需要使用气候模拟集合，才能对温室气体减排效益作出稳健估计。研究还表明，约束气候敏感性的估计并深化对CO2施肥效应的理解，可能显著缩小预测范围。

title: Assessing the Role of Group Heterogeneity in Community Forest Concessions in Guatemala's Maya Biosphere Reserve
abstract: We use land use data from Guatemala to estimate the impact of a community forest concession policy on avoided deforestation when accounting for group heterogeneity. Our analysis includes communities with significant forestry experience, along with communities comprising recent settlers with primarily agricultural backgrounds. Employing a matched difference-in-differences approach, we compare deforestation in community concessions relative to a matched control area. We find the concession policy reduced deforestation throughout the study region, with the most significant effects in the recently settled concessions. While there is also evidence of leakage in this group, overall, there is a net reduction in deforestation. (JEL Q57)
abstract_zh: 我们利用危地马拉的土地利用数据，在考虑群体异质性的情况下，估计社区森林特许经营政策对避免毁林的影响。我们的分析既包括拥有丰富林业经验的社区，也包括主要来自农业背景的新近定居者社区。采用匹配双重差分方法，我们比较了社区特许经营区与匹配对照区的毁林情况。我们发现，该特许经营政策在整个研究区域内减少了毁林，其中效果最显著的是新近定居者所在的特许经营区。尽管该群体中也存在泄漏的证据，但总体而言，毁林实现了净减少。（JEL Q57）

abstract: This paper develops an economic analysis of climate change impacts in the global forest sector. It illustrates how potential future climate change impacts can be integrated into a dynamic forestry economics model using data from a global dynamic vegetation model, the MC2 model. The results suggest that climate change will cause forest outputs (such as timber) to increase by approximately 30% over the century. Aboveground forest carbon storage also is projected to increase, by approximately 26 Pg C by 2115, as a result of climate change, potentially providing an offset to emissions from other sectors. The effects of climate mitigation policies in the energy sector are then examined. When climate mitigation in the energy sector reduces warming, we project a smaller increase in forest outputs over the timeframe of the analysis, and we project a reduction in the sink capacity of forests of around 12 Pg C by 2115.
abstract_zh: 本文对全球林业部门的气候变化影响进行了经济分析。文章阐明了如何利用全球动态植被模型MC2的数据，将潜在的未来气候变化影响纳入动态林业经济学模型。结果表明，气候变化将使森林产出（如木材）在本世纪内增加约30%。受气候变化影响，到2115年地上森林碳储量也预计增加约26 Pg C，这可能抵消其他部门的排放。随后，本文考察了能源部门气候减缓政策的效应。当能源部门的气候减缓降低了升温幅度时，我们预计在分析时段内森林产出的增幅较小，同时到2115年森林的碳汇能力将减少约12 Pg C。

title: Global solutions to regional problems: Collecting global expertise to address the problem of harmful cyanobacterial blooms
Impacts of a Tax Reform on the U.S. Timber Sector
Land Use Change, Carbon, And Bioenergy Reconsidered
abstract: Many environmentalists are concerned that renewable bioenergy, such as corn or wood ethanol will not reduce carbon emissions but will deplete forests. Using a general stylized forest sector management model, our study examines the economic potential of traditional industrial forests and supplemental dedicated fuelwood plantations to produce biomass on submarginal lands not suitable for most crop agriculture. The study finds that forests can economically produce large levels of biofuel without compromising crop production, thereby avoiding price pressures that lead to cropland conversion and carbon emissions.
abstract_zh: 许多环保人士担心，玉米或木质乙醇等可再生生物能源不但不会减少碳排放，反而会耗竭森林。本研究利用一个通用的程式化林业部门管理模型，考察了传统工业林和补充性的专用薪材人工林在不适于大多数作物农业的次边际土地上生产生物质的经济潜力。研究发现，森林能够在不影响作物生产的前提下，经济地生产大量生物燃料，从而避免了导致耕地转换和碳排放的价格压力。

title: Nutrient prices and concentrations in Midwestern agricultural watersheds

Transaction costs for carbon sequestration projects in the tropical forest sector
venue: Mitigation and Adaptation Strategies for Global Change
abstract: There is general consensus that carbon (C) sequestration projects in forests are a relatively low cost option for mitigating climate change, but most studies on the subject have assumed that transaction costs are negligible. The objectives of the study were to examine transaction costs for forest C sequestration projects and to determine the significance of the costs based on economic analyses. Here we examine four case studies of active C sequestration projects being implemented in tropical countries and developed for the C market. The results from the case studies were then used with a dynamic forest and land use economic model to investigate how transaction costs affect the efficiency and cost of forest C projects globally. In the case studies transaction costs ranged from 0.38 to 27 million US dollars ($0.09 to $7.71/t CO 2 ) or 0.3 to 270 % of anticipated income depending principally on the price of C and project size. The three largest cost categories were insurance (under the voluntary market; 41–89 % of total costs), monitoring (3–42 %) and regulatory approval (8–50 %). The global analysis indicated that most existing estimates of marginal costs of C sequestration are underestimated by up to 30 % because transaction costs were not included.
abstract_zh: 学界普遍认为，森林碳封存项目是缓解气候变化的相对低成本选择，但该领域的多数研究都假定交易成本可以忽略不计。本研究的目标是考察森林碳封存项目的交易成本，并基于经济分析判断这些成本的重要程度。在此，我们考察了在热带国家实施并面向碳市场开发的四个活跃碳封存项目案例。案例结果随后被用于一个动态森林与土地利用经济模型，以探究交易成本如何影响全球森林碳项目的效率与成本。在案例研究中，交易成本介于38万至2,700万美元之间（每吨CO2为0.09至7.71美元），占预期收入的0.3%至270%，主要取决于碳价和项目规模。三大成本类别分别为保险（自愿市场下占总成本的41%至89%）、监测（3%至42%）和监管审批（8%至50%）。全球分析表明，由于未计入交易成本，现有的大多数碳封存边际成本估计被低估了多达30%。

title: Wood Bioenergy and Land Use: A Challenge to the Searchinger Hypothesis
abstract: A concern of many environmentalists is that the use of biomass energy will decimate the forests. Searchinger et al. (2008, 2009) examined this issue related to corn ethanol and suggested that substituting corn ethanol for petroleum would increase carbon emissions associated with the land conversion abroad necessary to offset the decline in corn availability. Associated with these concerns is the overall issue of climate change (IPCC 2006). This issue is broader than simply corn. If agricultural croplands are drawn into the production of biofuel feedstocks, commodity prices are expected to rise, triggering land conversions overseas, releasing carbon emissions, and offsetting the carbon reductions expected from bioenergy. Using a general stylized forest sector management model, our study examines the economic potential of traditional industrial forests and supplemental dedicated fuelwood plantations to produce biomass on submarginal lands. It finds that these sources can economically produce large levels of biomass without compromising crop production, thereby mitigating the land conversion and carbon emissions effects posited by the Searchinger Hypothesis.
abstract_zh: 许多环保人士担忧，生物质能源的使用将摧毁森林。Searchinger等人（2008, 2009）针对玉米乙醇研究了这一问题，并指出以玉米乙醇替代石油，将因弥补玉米供应下降而在海外进行的土地转换而增加碳排放。与此相关的是气候变化这一总体问题（IPCC 2006）。该问题的范围比玉米更广。如果农业耕地被纳入生物燃料原料的生产，商品价格预计将上涨，从而引发海外的土地转换，释放碳排放，并抵消生物能源预期带来的碳减排。本研究利用一个通用的程式化林业部门管理模型，考察了传统工业林和补充性的专用薪材人工林在次边际土地上生产生物质的经济潜力。研究发现，这些来源能够在不损害作物生产的前提下，经济地生产大量生物质，从而缓解Searchinger假说所提出的土地转换和碳排放效应。

title: Wood as a Major Feedstock for Biofuel Production in the United States: Impacts on Forests and International Trade
abstract: The Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007 Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007, Pub. L. No. 110-140, 121 Stat. 1492 (2007). http://frwebgate.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/getdoc.cgi?dbname=110_cong_public_laws&docid=f:publ140.110.pdf (http://frwebgate.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/getdoc.cgi?dbname=110_cong_public_laws&docid=f:publ140.110.pdf) [Google Scholar] mandates large increases in ethanol for transport, from about 6 billion gallons current annual production to 36 billion gallons by 2022. The act mandates that large portions of ethanol be cellulosic ethanol. Although there are a number of potential feedstocks for cellulosic ethanol, it is highly likely that much of the feedstock will come from the timber base as raw wood, especially in the early years before grass production, and alternative feedstock, has become well-developed and infrastructure networks created. This article uses a well-known timber projections model to estimate the impact of the potential near doubling of demand for industrial type resulting from the mandates and finds that real prices could raise 15–20%. It also projects a large increase in the importation of processed wood products as domestic wood products production is crowded out by high raw wood prices.
abstract_zh: 《2007年能源独立与安全法案》（Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007，Pub. L. No. 110-140, 121 Stat. 1492 (2007)，链接：http://frwebgate.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/getdoc.cgi?dbname=110_cong_public_laws&docid=f:publ140.110.pdf）［Google Scholar］要求大幅增加交通用乙醇的产量，从当前每年约60亿加仑提高到2022年的360亿加仑。该法案规定，其中很大一部分乙醇必须是纤维素乙醇。尽管纤维素乙醇有多种潜在原料，但很可能有相当大一部分原料将来自木材原料基地，即以原木形式供应，特别是在草本原料及其替代原料的生产和基础设施网络充分发展之前的早期阶段。本文利用一个成熟的木材预测模型，估计该法规所导致的工业用材需求几近翻倍的影响，发现实际价格可能上涨15%至20%。研究还预测，由于国内木制品生产被高企的原木价格所挤出，加工木制品的进口量将大幅增加。

title: Carbon Sequestration in Forests and Soils
abstract: Forests can play a large role in climate change through the sequestration or emission of carbon, an important greenhouse gas; through biological growth, which can increase forest stocks; or through deforestation, which can increase carbon emissions. Carbon is captured not only in tree biomass but also in forest soils. Forest management and public policy can strongly influence the sequestration process. Economic policies can provide incentives for both forest expansion and contraction. Systems that provide prices for carbon sequestration or taxes for emissions can have important effects on emission and sequestration levels. Issues involve carbon additionality, permanence, and leakage. Forest measurement, monitoring, and verification also provide serious challenges. Various economic models are used to estimate the effects of various economic policies on forest carbon stocks. Estimates from the literature of some actual and potential levels of forest carbon are presented.
abstract_zh: 森林可以通过碳的封存或排放（碳是一种重要的温室气体）在气候变化中发挥重要作用；可以通过生物生长增加森林存量，也可以通过毁林增加碳排放。碳不仅被封存在树木生物量中，也被封存在森林土壤中。森林管理和公共政策可以强烈影响封存过程。经济政策既能激励森林扩张，也能激励森林收缩。为碳封存提供价格或对排放征税的制度，可以对排放和封存水平产生重要影响。相关问题包括碳的额外性、持久性和泄漏。森林的测量、监测与核查同样带来严峻挑战。多种经济模型被用于估计各种经济政策对森林碳储量的影响。本文还列出了文献中关于部分实际及潜在森林碳储量水平的估计值。

title: Costs of abandoned coal mine reclamation and associated recreation benefits in Ohio
Economic Approach to Assess the Forest Carbon Implications of Biomass Energy
abstract: There is widespread concern that biomass energy policy that promotes forests as a supply source will cause net carbon emissions. Most of the analyses that have been done to date, however, are biological, ignoring the effects of market adaptations through substitution, net imports, and timber investments. This paper uses a dynamic model of forest and land use management to estimate the impact of United States energy policies that emphasize the utilization of forest biomass on global timber production and carbon stocks over the next 50 years. We show that when market factors are included in the analysis, expanded demand for biomass energy increases timber prices and harvests, but reduces net global carbon emissions because higher wood prices lead to new investments in forest stocks. Estimates are sensitive to assumptions about whether harvest residues and new forestland can be used for biomass energy and the demand for biomass. Restricting biomass energy to being sourced only from roundwood on existing forestland can transform the policy from a net sink to a net source of emissions. These results illustrate the importance of capturing market adjustments and a large geographic scope when measuring the carbon implications of biomass energy policies.
abstract_zh: 人们普遍担心，将森林作为供应来源的生物质能源政策会导致净碳排放。然而，迄今为止的大多数分析都是生物学层面的，忽略了通过替代、净进口和木材投资所产生的市场适应效应。本文利用一个森林与土地利用管理的动态模型，估计美国着重利用森林生物质的能源政策，在未来50年内对全球木材产量和碳储量的影响。我们发现，当纳入市场因素时，生物质能源需求的扩大会提高木材价格并增加采伐量，但由于较高的木材价格引致了森林存量的新投资，全球净碳排放反而减少。估计结果对以下假设很敏感：采伐剩余物和新增林地是否可用于生物质能源，以及生物质需求的大小。若将生物质能源仅限于现有林地上的原木，则该政策可能从净碳汇转变为净排放源。这些结果说明了在衡量生物质能源政策的碳影响时，纳入市场调整并考虑广阔地理范围的重要性。

title: Global climate policy impacts on livestock, land use, livelihoods, and food security
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Recent research has shed light on the cost-effective contribution that agriculture can make to global greenhouse gas abatement; however, the resulting impacts on agricultural production, producer livelihoods, and food security remain largely unexplored. This paper provides an integrated assessment of the linkages between land-based climate policies, development, and food security, with a particular emphasis on abatement opportunities and impacts in the livestock sector. Targeting Annex I countries and exempting non-Annex I countries from land-based carbon policies on equity or food security grounds may result in significant leakage rates for livestock production and agriculture as a whole. We find that such leakage can be eliminated by supplying forest carbon sequestration incentives to non-Annex I countries. Furthermore, substantial additional global agricultural abatement can be attained by extending a greenhouse gas emissions tax to non-Annex I agricultural producers, while compensating them for their additional tax expenses. Because of their relatively large emissions intensities and limited abatement possibilities, ruminant meat producers face the greatest market adjustments to land-based climate policies. We also evaluate the impacts of climate policies on livelihoods and food consumption in developing countries. In the absence of non-Annex I abatement policies, these impacts are modest. However, strong income and food consumption impacts surface because of higher food costs after forest carbon sequestration is promoted at a global scale. Food consumption among unskilled labor households falls but rises for the representative farm households, because global agricultural supplies are restricted and farm prices rise sharply in the face of inelastic food demands.
abstract_zh: 近期研究已阐明农业对全球温室气体减排的成本有效贡献；然而，由此对农业生产、生产者生计和粮食安全带来的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探讨。本文对基于土地的气候政策、发展与粮食安全之间的联系进行了综合评估，尤其关注畜牧业中的减排机会及其影响。若以公平或粮食安全为由，将附件一国家作为目标，同时豁免非附件一国家的土地碳政策，可能导致畜牧业及整体农业出现显著的泄漏率。我们发现，通过向非附件一国家提供森林碳封存激励，可以消除此类泄漏。此外，将温室气体排放税扩大到非附件一国家的农业生产者，同时补偿其额外的税负，可以实现大量额外的全球农业减排。由于反刍动物肉类生产者的排放强度相对较大，且减排可能性有限，他们在应对基于土地的气候政策时面临最大的市场调整。我们还评估了气候政策对发展中国家生计和食品消费的影响。在缺乏非附件一国家减排政策的情况下，这些影响较为温和。然而，当森林碳封存在全球范围内推广后，由于粮食成本上升，将出现显著的收入和食品消费影响。由于全球农产品供应受限，且面对缺乏弹性的食品需求，农场价格急剧上涨，因此低技能劳动者家庭的食品消费下降，而代表性农户家庭的食品消费则上升。

title: An assessment of the influence of bioenergy and marketed land amenity values on land uses in the Midwestern US
Climate Change and Future Land Use in the United States: An Economic Approach
abstract: An econometric land-use model is used to project regional and national land-use changes in the United States under two IPCC emissions scenarios. The key driver of land-use change in the model is county-level measures of net returns to five major land uses. The net returns are modified for the IPCC scenarios according to assumed trends in population and income and projections from integrated assessment models of agricultural prices and agricultural and forestry yields. For both scenarios, we project large increases in urban land by the middle of the century, while the largest declines are in cropland area. Significant differences among regions in the projected patterns of land-use change are evident, including an expansion of forests in the Mountain and Plains regions with declines elsewhere. Comparisons to projections with no climate change effects on prices and yields reveal relatively small differences. Thus, our findings suggest that future land-use patterns in the U.S. will be shaped largely by urbanization, with climate change having a relatively small influence.
abstract_zh: 本文采用计量经济学土地利用模型，在两种IPCC排放情景下预测美国区域和全国的土地利用变化。模型中土地利用变化的关键驱动因素是县级层面五种主要土地用途的净收益。这些净收益根据人口与收入的假定趋势，以及综合评估模型对农产品价格和农林产量的预测进行了调整。两种情景下，我们都预计到本世纪中叶城市用地将大幅增加，而耕地面积下降幅度最大。不同地区在土地利用变化格局上存在显著差异，其中山地和平原地区的森林面积扩张，而其他地区则出现减少。与不考虑气候变化对价格和产量影响的预测相比，差异相对较小。因此，我们的研究结果表明，美国未来的土地利用格局将主要由城市化塑造，气候变化的影响相对较小。

title: Global Forest Carbon Sequestration and Climate Policy Design
venue: Journal of Environment and Development Economics
abstract: Global forests could play an important role in mitigating climate change. However, there are significant implementation obstacles to accessing the world's forest carbon sequestration potential. The timing of regional participation and eligibility of sequestration activities are issues. The existing forest carbon supply estimates have made optimistic assumptions about immediate, comprehensive, and global access. They have also assumed no interactions between activities and regions, and over time. We use a global forest and land use model to evaluate these assumptions with more realistic forest carbon policy pathways. We find that an afforestation only policy is fundamentally flawed, accelerated deforestation may be unavoidable, and a delayed comprehensive program could reduce, but not eliminate, near-term accelerated deforestation and eventually produce sequestration equivalent to idealized policies – but with a different sequestration mix than previously estimated by others and thereby different forests. We also find that afforestation and avoided deforestation increase the cost of one another.
abstract_zh: 全球森林可以在缓解气候变化中发挥重要作用。然而，要获取世界森林的碳封存潜力，仍面临重大的实施障碍。各地区参与的时机以及封存活动的合格性是其中的问题。现有的森林碳供给估计对即时、全面且全球范围的获取作出了乐观假设。这些估计还假定各项活动之间、各地区之间以及不同时期之间不存在相互作用。我们利用一个全球森林与土地利用模型，以更为现实的森林碳政策路径检验这些假设。我们发现，仅实施造林的政策存在根本缺陷，加速毁林可能难以避免；而延迟实施的全面计划可以减少但无法消除近期的加速毁林，并最终产生与理想化政策相当的封存量，但其封存构成与他人此前的估计不同，因而所对应的森林也不同。我们还发现，造林与避免毁林会相互提高彼此的成本。

title: Importance of Crop Yield in Calibrating Watershed Water Quality Simulation Tools
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: Surendran Nair, Sujithkumar, Kevin W. King, Jonathan D. Witter, Brent L. Sohngen, and Norman R. Fausey, 2011. Importance of Crop Yield in Calibrating Watershed Water Quality Simulation Tools. Journal of the American Water Resources Association (JAWRA) 47(6):1285–1297. DOI: 10.1111/j.1752-1688.2011.00570.x Abstract: Watershed-scale water-quality simulation tools provide a convenient and economical means to evaluate the environmental impacts of conservation practices. However, confidence in the simulation tool’s ability to accurately represent and capture the inherent variability of a watershed is dependent upon high quality input data and subsequent calibration. A four-stage iterative and rigorous calibration procedure is outlined and demonstrated for Soil Water Analysis Tool (SWAT) using data from Upper Big Walnut Creek (UBWC) watershed in central Ohio, USA. The four stages and the sequence of their application were: (1) parameter selection, (2) hydrology calibration, (3) crop yield calibration, and (4) nutrient loading calibration. Following the calibration, validation was completed on a 10 year period. Nash-Sutcliffe efficiencies for streamflow over the validation period were 0.5 for daily, 0.86 for monthly, and 0.87 for annual. Prediction efficiencies for crop yields during the validation period were 0.69 for corn, 0.54 for soybeans, and 0.61 for wheat. Nitrogen loading prediction efficiency was 0.66. Compared to traditional calibration approaches (no crop yield calibration), the four-stage approach (with crop yield calibration) produced improved prediction efficiencies, especially for nutrient balances.
abstract_zh:
Surendran Nair, Sujithkumar, Kevin W. King, Jonathan D. Witter, Brent L. Sohngen, and Norman R. Fausey, 2011. 作物产量在校准流域水质模拟工具中的重要性。《美国水资源协会杂志》（JAWRA）47(6):1285–1297。DOI: 10.1111/j.1752-1688.2011.00570.x
摘要：流域尺度的水质模拟工具为评估保护性耕作措施的环境影响提供了便捷且经济的手段。然而，模拟工具能否准确反映并捕捉流域固有的变异性，取决于高质量的输入数据以及随后的校准。本文以美国俄亥俄州中部上大沃尔纳特溪（UBWC）流域为例，概述并演示了一套四阶段迭代且严谨的校准程序，所用模型为土壤水分分析工具（SWAT）。四个阶段及其应用顺序为：(1) 参数选择，(2) 水文校准，(3) 作物产量校准，(4) 养分负荷校准。校准完成后，我们以10年时段完成了验证。验证期内径流的Nash-Sutcliffe效率：日尺度为0.5，月尺度为0.86，年尺度为0.87。验证期内作物产量的预测效率：玉米为0.69，大豆为0.54，小麦为0.61。氮负荷的预测效率为0.66。与传统校准方法（不进行作物产量校准）相比，包含作物产量校准的四阶段方法提高了预测效率，尤其是在养分平衡方面。

title: Total Factor Productivity Change in Agriculture and Emissions from Deforestation
Optimal Forest Management With Carbon Sequestration Credits And Endogenous Fire Risk
abstract: We use a stochastic dynamic profit maximization model to investigate the effects of forest carbon sequestration credits on optimal forest management practices for stands facing wildfire risk. Landowners that periodically thin a stand can increase growth rates and mitigate loss of timber and carbon stocks from wildfire. Results indicate that thinning and shortening rotations are cost-effective strategies to mitigate wildfire risk. Carbon prices cause landowners to delay both their thinning treatments and the final rotation age. Thinning and extending timber rotations are thus a viable climate-change mitigation option even when stands are susceptible to risks of fire. (JEL Q23, Q54)
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个随机动态利润最大化模型，研究森林碳封存信用对面临野火风险的林分最优森林管理实践的影响。定期进行疏伐的林地所有者可以提高生长速度，并减轻野火造成的木材和碳储量损失。结果表明，疏伐和缩短轮伐期是具有成本效益的降低野火风险策略。碳价促使林地所有者推迟疏伐处理和最终轮伐年龄。因此，即使林分面临火灾风险，疏伐和延长木材轮伐期仍是可行的气候变化减缓选项。（JEL Q23, Q54）

title: The optimal choice of residue management, crop rotations, and cost of carbon sequestration: Empirical results in the Midwest US
Set-Asides for Carbon Sequestration: Implications for Permanence and Leakage
The opportunity cost of land use and the global potential for greenhouse gas mitigation in agriculture and forestry
abstract: This paper analyzes the role of global land-use in determining potential greenhouse gas mitigation by land-based activities in agriculture and forestry. Land-based activities are responsible for over a third of global greenhouse gas emissions, yet the economics of land-use decisions have not been explicitly modeled in global mitigation studies. In this paper, we develop a new, general equilibrium framework which effectively captures the opportunity costs of land-use decisions in agriculture and forestry, thereby allowing us to analyze competition for heterogeneous land types across and within sectors and input substitution between land and other factors of production. In our analysis of carbon taxation, we find significant changes in the global pattern of comparative advantage as a result of differential mitigation costs across sectors, regions, and land types. We find that forest carbon sequestration is the dominant strategy for GHG emissions mitigation globally in the land using sectors. However, when compared to the rest of the world, land-use emissions abatement in the US and China comes disproportionately from agriculture, and, within agriculture, disproportionately from reductions in fertilizer-related emissions. In the world as a whole, agriculture-related mitigation comes predominantly from reduced methane emissions in the ruminant livestock sector, followed by fertilizer and methane emissions from paddy rice. The results also show how analyses that only consider regional mitigation may under- or over-estimate mitigation potential. For example, U.S.-specific analyses likely over-estimate the potential for abatement in agriculture. Finally, we note that this general equilibrium framework provides the research community with a practical methodology for explicit modeling of global land competition and land-based mitigation in comprehensive assessments of greenhouse gas mitigation options.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了全球土地利用在决定农业和林业中以土地为基础的活动所具有的温室气体减排潜力方面的作用。以土地为基础的活动造成了全球温室气体排放的三分之一以上，但土地利用决策的经济学尚未在全球减排研究中得到明确建模。本文构建了一个新的一般均衡框架，有效刻画了农业和林业土地利用决策的机会成本，从而使我们能够分析不同类型土地在部门间和部门内的竞争，以及土地与其他生产要素之间的投入替代。在碳税分析中，我们发现，由于不同部门、地区和土地类型之间减排成本的差异，全球比较优势格局发生了显著变化。我们发现，在全球土地利用部门中，森林碳封存是温室气体减排的主导策略。然而，与世界其他地区相比，美国和中国的土地利用减排更多来自农业，而在农业内部，又更多来自与化肥相关的排放削减。从全球整体看，农业相关减排主要来自反刍家畜部门甲烷排放的减少，其次是稻田化肥和甲烷排放的减少。研究结果还表明，仅考虑区域减排的分析可能会低估或高估减排潜力。例如，针对美国的分析很可能高估了农业减排潜力。最后，我们指出，该一般均衡框架为研究界提供了一种实用方法论，可用于在全面的温室气体减排评估中，对全球土地竞争和以土地为基础的减排进行明确建模。

title: Avoided Deforestation as a Greenhouse Gas Mitigation Tool: Economic Issues
abstract:
Tropical deforestation is a significant contributor to accumulation of greenhouse gases (GHGs) in the atmosphere. GHG emissions from deforestation in the tropics were in the range of 1 to 2 Pg C yr
−1
for the 1990s, which is equivalent to as much as 25% of global anthropogenic GHG emissions. While there is growing interest in providing incentives to avoid deforestation and consequently reduce net carbon emissions, there is limited information available on the potential costs of these activities. This paper uses a global forestry and land use model to analyze the potential marginal costs of reducing net carbon emissions by avoiding deforestation in tropical countries. Our estimates suggest that about 0.1 Pg C yr
−1
of emissions reductions could be obtained over the next 30 to 50 yr for $5 per Mg C, and about 1.6 Pg C yr
−1
could be obtained over the same time frame for $100 per Mg C. In addition, the effects of carbon incentives on land use could be substantial. Relative to projected baseline conditions, we find that there would be around 3 million additional hectares (ha) of forestland in 2055 at $5 per Mg C and 422 million ha at $100 per Mg C. Estimates of reductions in area deforested, GHG mitigation potential, and annual land rental payments required are presented, all of which vary by region, carbon price paid, and time frame of mitigation.
abstract_zh: 热带毁林是大气中温室气体累积的重要来源。20世纪90年代，热带毁林产生的温室气体排放量在每年1至2 Pg C之间，相当于全球人为温室气体排放量的多达25%。尽管人们对通过激励措施避免毁林、从而减少净碳排放的兴趣日益增长，但关于这些活动潜在成本的信息仅有限。本文利用一个全球林业与土地利用模型，分析在热带国家通过避免毁林来减少净碳排放的潜在边际成本。我们的估计表明，在未来30至50年内，若每吨碳支付5美元，约可获得每年0.1 Pg C的减排量；而在同一时段内，若每吨碳支付100美元，则可获得每年约1.6 Pg C的减排量。此外，碳激励对土地利用的影响可能相当显著。相对于预计的基准情景，我们发现，2055年每吨碳5美元时将额外增加约300万公顷（ha）林地，每吨碳100美元时将额外增加4.22亿公顷林地。减少的毁林面积、温室气体减排潜力以及所需的年度土地租金支付等估计结果，均因地区、所支付的碳价以及减排时间跨度而异。

title: Exchange Rates and the Competitiveness of the United States Timber Sector in a Global Economy
Extending Timber Rotations: Carbon and Cost Implications
abstract: A number of studies have suggested that incentives for carbon sequestration could lead to longer rotation periods for even-aged managed forests. In this article we examine the potential costs and quantity of sequestered carbon from extending rotation ages in softwood forests of the southern and western USA. A model of optimal rotations when carbon is a valued asset was developed to show how optimal rotations adjust when carbon is priced. Data on 324 types and site classes of softwood forests in southern and western states of the USA were used to examine the costs of extending rotations. The results were then aggregated by applying the marginal cost curves to inventory data within each county in these states. The results indicate that in these 12 states, about 15 million tCO2 could be sequestered for less than $7/tCO2 (1 tCO2 = 1,000 kg CO2), although for substantially higher carbon prices of $55/tCO2, up to 209 million tCO2 could be sequestered. Timber prices were found to have an important influence on the marginal costs of carbon sequestration, with site quality being of secondary importance. The results also showed that at $55/tCO2 potentially 1 million ha of softwood forests could be set aside, mostly in the western states.
abstract_zh: 多项研究表明，碳封存激励可能使同龄管理林地的轮伐期延长。本文考察了美国南部和西部针叶林延长轮伐期的潜在成本及可封存碳的数量。我们构建了一个当碳被视为有价资产时的最优轮伐期模型，以展示碳定价时最优轮伐期如何调整。我们使用了这些州中324种针叶林类型和立地等级的数据，考察延长轮伐期的成本。随后，我们将边际成本曲线应用于这些州各县的森林清查数据，对结果进行了汇总。结果表明，在这12个州中，约有1500万吨CO2可以以低于每吨7美元（1 tCO2 = 1,000 kg CO2）的成本封存；而当碳价大幅提高至每吨CO2 55美元时，可封存量可达2.09亿吨CO2。木材价格对碳封存的边际成本具有重要影响，而立地质量的影响居次要地位。结果还显示，当碳价为每吨CO2 55美元时，潜在可划出100万公顷针叶林，且这些林地主要位于西部各州。

title: Global cost estimates of reducing carbon emissions through avoided deforestation
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
Tropical deforestation is estimated to cause about one-quarter of anthropogenic carbon emissions, loss of biodiversity, and other environmental services. United Nations Framework Convention for Climate Change talks are now considering mechanisms for avoiding deforestation (AD), but the economic potential of AD has yet to be addressed. We use three economic models of global land use and management to analyze the potential contribution of AD activities to reduced greenhouse gas emissions. AD activities are found to be a competitive, low-cost abatement option. A program providing a 10% reduction in deforestation from 2005 to 2030 could provide 0.3–0.6 Gt (1 Gt = 1 × 10
5
g) CO
2
·yr
−1
in emission reductions and would require $0.4 billion to $1.7 billion·yr
−1
for 30 years. A 50% reduction in deforestation from 2005 to 2030 could provide 1.5–2.7 Gt CO
2
·yr
−1
in emission reductions and would require $17.2 billion to $28.0 billion·yr
−1
. Finally, some caveats to the analysis that could increase costs of AD programs are described.
abstract_zh: 据估计，热带毁林导致的人为碳排放约占四分之一，同时还造成生物多样性丧失及其他环境服务的损失。《联合国气候变化框架公约》谈判目前正在考虑避免毁林（AD）的机制，但避免毁林的经济潜力尚未得到探讨。我们利用三个全球土地利用与管理经济模型，分析避免毁林活动对减少温室气体排放的潜在贡献。研究发现，避免毁林是一种具有竞争力的低成本减排选项。一项在2005至2030年间将毁林减少10%的计划，每年可产生0.3至0.6 Gt（1 Gt = 1 × 10^5 g）CO2·yr⁻¹的减排量，并且在30年内每年需要4亿至17亿美元·yr⁻¹的资金。若在2005至2030年间将毁林减少50%，每年可产生1.5至2.7 Gt CO2·yr⁻¹的减排量，但每年需要172亿至280亿美元·yr⁻¹的资金。最后，本文描述了可能增加避免毁林项目成本的若干分析局限性。

title: Economic Consequences of Consideration of Permanence, Leakage and Additionality for Soil Carbon Sequestration Projects
Economics of Forest Ecosystem Carbon Sinks: A Review
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: Carbon terrestrial sinks are seen as a low-cost alternative to fuel switching and reduced fossil fuel use for lowering atmospheric CO2. In this study, we review issues related to the use of terrestrial forestry activities to create CO2 offset credits. To gain a deeper understanding of the confusing empirical studies of forest projects to create carbon credits under Kyoto, we employ meta-regression analysis to analyze conditions under which forest activities generate CO2-emission reduction offsets at competitive "prices." In particular, we examine 68 studies of the costs of creating carbon offsets using forestry. Baseline estimates of costs of sequestering carbon are some US$3–$280 per tCO2, indicating that the costs of creating CO2-emission offset credits through forestry activities vary wildly. Intensive plantations in the tropics could potentially yield positive benefits to society, but in Europe similar projects could cost as much as $195/tCO2. Indeed, Europe is the highest cost region, with costs in the range of $50–$280 per tCO2. This might explain why Europe has generally opposed biological sinks as a substitute for emissions reductions, while countries rush to finance forestry sector clean development mechanism projects. In Canada and the U.S., carbon sequestration costs range from a low of about $2 to nearly $80 per tCO2. One conclusion is obvious: some forestry projects to sequester carbon are worthwhile undertaking, but certainly not all.
abstract_zh: 陆地碳汇被视为替代燃料转换和减少化石燃料使用、以降低大气CO2浓度的低成本选择。本研究回顾了利用陆地林业活动创造CO2抵消信用所涉及的若干问题。为深入理解关于《京都议定书》下森林碳信用项目的复杂实证研究，我们采用元回归分析，考察森林活动在何种条件下能够以具有竞争力的“价格”产生CO2减排抵消量。具体而言，我们考察了68项关于利用林业创造碳抵消量成本的研究。基准估计显示，封存碳的成本约为每吨CO2 3至280美元，表明通过林业活动创造CO2减排抵消信用的成本差异极大。在热带地区，集约化人工林可能给社会带来正收益，但在欧洲，类似项目的成本可能高达每吨CO2 195美元。事实上，欧洲是成本最高的地区，成本区间为每吨CO2 50至280美元。这或许可以解释，为何欧洲普遍反对将生物碳汇作为减排的替代手段，同时各国又争相为林业部门的清洁发展机制项目提供资金。在加拿大和美国，碳封存成本从每吨CO2约2美元到接近80美元不等。有一个结论是显而易见的：一些森林碳封存项目是值得开展的，但肯定不是所有项目都值得。

title: Forestry and the carbon market response to stabilize climate
abstract: This paper investigates the potential contribution of forestry management in meeting a CO2 stabilization policy of 550 ppmv by 2100. In order to assess the optimal response of the carbon market to forest sequestration we couple two global models. An energy-economyclimate model for the study of climate policies is linked with a detailed forestry model through an iterative procedure to provide the optimal abatement strategy. Results show that forestry is a determinant abatement option and could lead to significantly lower policy costs if included. Linking forestry management to the carbon market has the potential to alleviate the policy burden of 50ppmv or equivalently of 1/4 of degrees C, and to significantly decrease the price of carbon. Biological sequestration will mostly come from avoided deforestation in tropical forests rich countries. The inclusion of this mitigation option is demonstrated to crowd out some of the traditional abatement in the energy sector and to lessen induced technological change in clean technologies.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了林业管理在实现2100年前将CO2浓度稳定在550 ppmv这一政策目标中可能发挥的作用。为评估碳市场对森林碳汇的最优响应，我们耦合了两个全球模型。一个用于气候政策研究的能源—经济—气候模型，通过迭代程序与一个详细的林业模型相连接，以提供最优减排策略。结果表明，林业是一项决定性的减排选项，若将其纳入，可显著降低政策成本。将林业管理与碳市场相连接，有可能减轻50 ppmv（或等价于1/4摄氏度）的政策负担，并显著降低碳价。生物固碳将主要来自富有热带森林国家的避免毁林。研究表明，纳入这一减排选项会挤出能源部门的部分传统减排，并削弱清洁技术中的诱致性技术变革。

title: Adaptive Management of the Global Climate Problem: Bridging the Gap between Climate Research and Climate Policy
Carbon Sequestration in Global Forests Under Different Carbon Price Regimes
abstract: This paper examines the potential role of carbon sequestration in forests under a range of exogenously chosen carbon price paths. The price paths were chosen to simulate several different climate change policies. The results indicate that global sequestration could range from 48-147 Pg C by 2105 for carbon prices ranging from $100 to more than $800 per t C by the end of the century. The timing of sequestration is found to be sensitive to the assumed carbon price path. Low initial carbon prices ($10 - $20 per t C in 2010) followed by rapid price increases, as might occur if policy makers try to stabilize future concentrations, suggest little, if any, sequestration during the next 20 years (-0.2 to 4.5 Pg C). If policy makers develop policies that support higher initial carbon prices, ranging from $75 to $100 per t C, 17 to 23 Pg C could be sequestered in forests over the next 20 years. Overall, our results indicate that forestry is not an efficient stopgap measure for long-term policy goals, but that it is instead an important longterm partner with other mitigation options.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在一系列外生选择的碳价路径下，森林碳封存可能发挥的作用。这些价格路径被设计用来模拟若干种不同的气候变化政策。结果表明，到2105年，全球森林碳封存量可在48至147 Pg C之间，对应本世纪末碳价从每吨碳100美元到800多美元不等。研究发现，封存的时间安排对所设定的碳价路径十分敏感。若初始碳价较低（2010年每吨碳10至20美元），随后迅速上涨（例如政策制定者试图稳定未来浓度时可能出现的情况），则未来20年内几乎不会有封存（-0.2至4.5 Pg C）。若政策制定者推行较高的初始碳价，即每吨碳75至100美元，则未来20年内森林可封存17至23 Pg C。总体而言，我们的结果表明，林业并非实现长期政策目标的有效权宜之计，但它是与其他减排选项相互配合的重要长期伙伴。

title: Economy, Politics and Institutions: From Adaptation to Adaptive Management in Climate Change
Modeling Multiple-Objective Trips with Choices over Trip Duration and Alternative Sites
venue: Journal of Environmental and Resource Economics

title: The Influence of Conversion of Forest Types on Carbon Sequestration and other Ecosystem Services in the South Central United States
Un-Tapped Resources? The Value of Steelhead Angling in Lake Erie Tributaries
Impacts of Climate Change on Forest Product Markets: Implications for North American Producers
abstract: This paper examines potential climate change impacts in North American timber markets. The results indicate that climate change could increase productivity in forests in North America, increase productivity in forests globally, and reduce timber prices. North American consumers generally will gain from the potential changes, but producers could lose welfare. If dieback resulting from additional forest fires, increased pest infestation, or storm damage increases appreciably and has market effects, consumers will gain less and producers will lose more than if climate change simply increases the annual flow of timber products by raising forest productivity. Annual producers' surplus losses from climate change in the North American timber sector are estimated to range from $1.4 – $2.1 billion per year on average over the next century, with the higher number resulting from potential large-scale dieback. Within North America, existing studies suggest that producers in northern regions are less susceptible to climate change impacts than producers in southern regions because many climate and ecological models suggest that climates become dryer in the U.S. South. Key words: climate change, impact analysis, timber markets, forest ecosystems
abstract_zh: 本文考察了气候变化对北美木材市场的潜在影响。结果表明，气候变化可能提高北美森林的生产力，提高全球森林的生产力，并降低木材价格。北美消费者总体上将从这些潜在变化中获益，但生产者的福利可能受损。若因额外的森林火灾、虫害增加或风暴损害导致林木大面积枯死，并对市场产生明显影响，那么消费者获益将减少，生产者损失将增加，其程度将超过气候变化仅通过提高森林生产力而增加木材产品年供给量的情形。据估计，在下个世纪内，气候变化对北美木材部门生产者剩余造成的年均损失为每年14亿至21亿美元，其中较高的数字源于可能发生的大规模林木枯死。在北美内部，现有研究表明，北方地区的生产者比南方地区的生产者更不易受气候变化影响，因为许多气候和生态模型预测美国南部气候将变得更为干燥。关键词：气候变化，影响分析，木材市场，森林生态系统

title: Group Performance Contracts for Voluntary Nonpoint Source Pollution Control: Evidence from Experimental Auctions
Measuring Leakage from Carbon Projects in Open Economies: A Stop Timber Harvesting Project as a Case Study
abstract: This paper develops methods for estimating leakage from forest-based carbon projects that seek to reduce carbon emissions from timber harvesting in tropical forests. A theoretical framework is presented in which a specific country, in this case Bolivia, is treated as a supplier to the global timber market. Leakage is measured, over a 30- to 50-year time period, as the difference in net national carbon emissions from timber harvesting between the baseline case and a scenario in which some of the land is removed from the concession base. Estimates of timber leakage are made for several different assumptions about future global sequestration policies, capital constraints, demand elasticity, and deadwood decomposition rates. The results suggest that leakage could range from 5% to 42% without discounting carbon, and from 2% to 38% when carbon is discounted. Demand elasticity and wood decomposition rates have the largest effects on the leakage calculation. Leakage is lowest when demand is more elastic and wood decomposition rates are faster, and vice-versa when these conditions are reversed. Leakage appears to be sensitive to capital constraints only when project benefits are measured over a shorter time period.
abstract_zh: 本文发展了估计森林碳项目泄漏的方法，这些项目旨在减少热带森林中木材采伐所产生的碳排放。文中提出了一个理论框架，将特定国家（本文以玻利维亚为例）视为全球木材市场的供应方。泄漏量被定义为在30至50年的时间跨度内，基准情景与部分土地被移出采伐特许经营基地的情景之间，木材采伐所产生的国家净碳排放差异。我们在多种假设下估计了木材泄漏，包括未来全球碳封存政策、资本约束、需求弹性以及枯木分解速率。结果表明，若不对碳进行贴现，泄漏可能在5%至42%之间；若对碳进行贴现，则在2%至38%之间。需求弹性和木材分解速率对泄漏计算的影响最大。当需求弹性较大且木材分解速率较快时，泄漏最低；反之则泄漏最高。只有在项目效益的衡量时间较短时，泄漏才对资本约束表现出敏感性。

title: The Value of Agricultural Economics Extension Programming: An Application of Contingent Valuation
abstract: We use the contingent valuation method to estimate participant willingness to pay for agricultural economics extension programming. The data, collected as part of standard evaluation forms for the Ohio State University's 2001 Agricultural Outlook and Policy program series, and subsequent analysis suggest participant benefits exceeded departmental costs of conducting the program (benefit-cost ratios of 1.07 under conservative assumptions and 1.74 under moderate assumptions). We also use the data to explore the revenue generation potential from alternative program pricing and discuss the potential for developing differentiated programs to reach distinct audience segments. Additional research necessary before implementing alternative pricing or program differentiation plans is also discussed.
abstract_zh: 我们采用条件价值评估法（contingent valuation）估计参与者为农业经济推广项目支付的意愿。数据来源于俄亥俄州立大学2001年“农业展望与政策”系列项目的标准评估表，经后续分析表明，参与者的收益超过了该系开展项目的成本（在保守假设下收益成本比为1.07，在适中假设下为1.74）。我们还利用这些数据探讨了不同项目定价方式下的收入创造潜力，并讨论了开发差异化项目以覆盖不同受众群体的可能性。文中还讨论了在实施替代定价或项目差异化计划之前仍需开展的研究。

title: What are the Impacts of Global Warming on U.S. Forests, Regions, and the U.S. Timber Industry?
An Optimal Control Model of Forest Carbon Sequestration
abstract: This study develops an optimal control model of carbon sequestration and energy abatement to explore the potential role of forests in greenhouse gas mitigation. The article shows that if carbon accumulates in the atmosphere, the rental price for carbon sequestration should rise over time. From an empirical model, we find that carbon sequestration is costly, but that landowners can sequester substantial amounts of carbon in forests mainly by increasing forestland and lengthening rotations. Forest sequestration is predicted to account for about one‐third of total carbon abatement. Tropical forests store over two‐thirds of this added carbon.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个碳封存与能源减排的最优控制模型，以探讨森林在温室气体减排中可能发挥的作用。文章表明，若碳在大气中累积，则碳封存的租金价格应随时间上升。基于一个实证模型，我们发现碳封存成本高昂，但土地所有者可以主要通过增加林地面积和延长轮伐期，在森林中封存大量碳。预计森林碳封存约占总碳减排量的三分之一。热带森林储存了新增碳的三分之二以上。

title: Zoning, Development Timing, and Agricultural Land Use at the Suburban Fringe: A Competing Risks Approach
abstract: Competing risks survival analysis is used to investigate tax and zoning policy impacts on residential, commercial, and industrial development timing in a rapidly growing Midwestern county. Industrial development appears both to precede and occur concurrently with residential development, while commercial development follows other types. Although residences appear to locate away from industrial land, zoning decisions favoring industry may attract rather than deter residential development within a jurisdiction. Regions with higher infrastructure taxes experience development later. Because school taxes fund local public goods important to homeowners, they have little influence on residential timing, but strong influences on industrial and commercial timing.
abstract_zh: 本文运用竞争风险生存分析，考察了一个快速增长的中西部县中税收和分区政策对住宅、商业和工业开发时机的影响。工业开发似乎先于住宅开发发生，并与之同时发生，而商业开发则紧随其他类型之后。尽管住宅倾向于远离工业用地，但有利于工业的分区决策可能会吸引而非阻止辖区内的住宅开发。基础设施税较高的地区，开发时间较晚。由于学校税收用于为房主所重视的地方公共物品提供资金，它们对住宅开发时机的影响很小，但对工业和商业开发时机有很强的影响。
